A '''[[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]''' was stationed on the [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]] [[Rishi moon]] and participated in the [[Defense of Rishi Station/Legends|Battle of the Rishi moon]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].

==History==
During the battle, this droid was part of a reinforcement squadron sent to a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Listening post/Legends|listening post]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] after the initial team of [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|BX-series droid commandos]] sent to capture the base were no longer transmitting back. After arriving at the base, the droids managed to drive of the remaining squadron of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] stationed there, with the exception of [[Hevy/Legends|Hevy]]. After the clone was discovered and badly wounded by the droids, including this one, he managed to set off a [[Tibanna/Legends|liquid tibanna]] bomb, killing himself along with the whole droid squadron and destroying the listening post.
